meta.title: Where to find us
meta.description: Address and map of the BUDO CLUB dojo on Tyršova street in Mariánské Lázně.

directionsP1: The building is located on Tyršova street behind the ice rink. Key landmarks are the swimming pool and the Kaufland store. From Kaufland, continue towards the ice rink – you will find our gym just behind it.
directionsP2: If you have trouble finding us, call 602 492 903 or 607 517 967 and we will guide you.
